notes.title: Now fully compatible with Steam Deck
notes.content:
[h1]All Hands on Steam Deck![/h1]
Great news: Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet is now fully compatible with Steam Deck, fully supports the gamepad and can be played with touch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12532752/22c0f28bf6cc5c2bf5522c3b21058d3aa1fc1caa.png[/img]

And one more thing in case you have missed it: Alasdair Beckett-King has a YouTube channel with great comedy. 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/c/ABeckettKing]Check it out here.[/url]

notes.title: Commentary Ahoy!
notes.content:
[h1]Developer commentary[/h1]
We have updated [i]Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet[/i] with a developer's commentary. Alasdair Beckett-King and real Nelly (aka Rachel) sat down and recorded funny and interesting background information. The audio tracks unlock as you play and you can listen to them whenever you want. This may be a good reason to play the game again if you have finished it already or another reason to buy it if you haven't bought it yet.

[h1]Gamepad support[/h1]
Now the version for PC, Mac and Linux supports gamepad/controller input. For PC it should work with standard XBOX and compatible controllers. We know that there are many controllers out there, so we can't promise all of them will work. We did our best to support most models and picked a very popular library to add controller support.

For macOS it depends what kind of controller you have and how it is supported by system extensions. XBOX compatible controllers work for us.

For Linux we support the standard profile for controllers. Our tests with XBOX compatible controllers have been successful.
